effectivePlan: Aim for nine tricks: DA/DK, HA/HK, SA, and four clubs. After South wins DQ with DA, cash DK. Then cash CA and CK, and lead C4 to dummy’s CQ; with CA and CK already gone, CQ beats every outstanding club. From dummy cash HK, then lead C2 toward South’s C8/6/4 to try to establish a fourth club. Keep HA and SA as stoppers while testing clubs; if South wins the continuation, cash them. Reassess if defenders take the club lead, since the extra club trick depends on their remaining holdings.
